verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only single-request operations: POST /v1/listen per file, a per-request callback URL, and CLI commands with exit codes for scripting. No batch or bulk endpoint for acting on many items at once is documented. Scriptable exit codes and async callbacks are building blocks a user could wrap in their own loop, not a native bulk-operations capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
